messages.author: 14a9c600457bb4c3
messages.subject: trouble with www.shinyapps.io,  shinyapps::deployApp()
parts:
I created a shiny app and uploaded it to https://github.com/alexzolot/SHC/ .
It runs OK locally, via shiny http server, or  via  shiny::runGitHub( "SHC", "alexzolot") .    
But when I try upload it to  www.shinyapps.io following instructions  https://www.shinyapps.io/admin/#/dashboard, then I got errors:
>shinyapps::setAccountInfo(name='alexzolot', token='...', secret='...') 
# Error in formatDL(rep.int(tag, length(val)), val, style = "list", width = width, indent = indent)
#   incorrect values of 'indent' and 'width'

>shinyapps::deployApp()        
# Error in mapply(function(from, to) paste(lines[from:to], collapse = "\n"),  : 
#  zero-length inputs cannot be mixed with those of non-zero length

Could somebody advice how to fix it?
